note: Source-verified 2026-08-08 against whiteheadlatorrey1-boop/tsm-rcm by reading real ids/onclick handlers directly in html/war-rooms/music-war/{index,cadence-builder,presentation-live}.html. Music Command isn't BNCA/relay-wired (no war-room -> strategist -> exec-portal chain), so this story walks its real two live-AI surfaces instead: Cadence Studio's analyzeFlow() (POST /api/music/structure via SMOS.askJSON, confirmed real inline handler in server.js) and presentation-live.html's runLiveChain() (POST /api/music/agent/chain, the real ZAY->RIYA->DJ sequential Groq chain). Bars/lyrics used are original sample lines written for this story, not lifted from any copyrighted song. 'Generate 10 Hooks' was deliberately left out of this story -- verified it has no wired UI trigger anywhere in the app (only appears as static $25 marketing copy in release/marketing.html and how-to-guide.html), so scripting a click on it would be staging a feature that doesn't exist for real users. presentation-live.html defaults its demo_token to 'public' when none is set, so the access-gate script never blocks these clicks.
